definitions.explanation: A newspaper, magazine, or other publication that is issued every day. Often used as a prefix in newspaper names.

examples.japanese: {日刊|にっかん}{紙|し}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいる→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日刊|にっかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}される→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: This news site is updated daily.

examples.japanese: {日刊|にっかん}⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧だ。
examples.english: Nikkan Sports is a well-known Japanese sports newspaper.

notes:
Used as a modifier or prefix indicating daily frequency of publication. Very common in newspaper names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日刊|にっかん}{紙|し}: daily newspaper
- {日刊|にっかん}⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧: daily newspaper
- {日刊|にっかん}⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧: Nikkan Sports (newspaper name)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{週刊|しゅうかん}→週刊：14373_shuukan⟧: weekly publication
- ⟦{月刊|げっかん}→月刊：16257_gekkan⟧: monthly publication
- ⟦{朝刊|ちょうかん}→朝刊：16382_choukan⟧: morning edition
- ⟦{夕刊|ゆうかん}→夕刊：18550_yuukan⟧: evening edition

ETYMOLOGY:
Combines ⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧ (day) and {刊|かん} (publish/edition). The same {刊|かん} appears in ⟦{週刊|しゅうかん}→週刊：14373_shuukan⟧ and ⟦{月刊|げっかん}→月刊：16257_gekkan⟧.
